title: Top Hats at Sunset Shore
description: Four men in black top hats and long coats stand on a dark rocky shore, examining and handling piles of gold coins scattered at their feet. Behind them is a dramatic blood-red and orange sunset over a turbulent sea with sailing ships on the horizon.
prompt: Four mysterious men wearing black top hats and long coats stand together on a jagged dark rocky outcrop at the edge of the sea, one gesturing while they examine and count piles of shiny gold coins scattered on the ground around them, dramatic blood orange and red sunset with a bright sun on the horizon over choppy dark waves, several old sailing ships visible in the distance, high contrast black and white foreground with glowing coins, surreal ominous atmosphere, cinematic lighting
